units.source_text: 那天，恰好我们俩上课时间相同，吃完早饭，我们就一起出了门。

en.t: That day, our class schedules happened to be the same, so after breakfast we left the house together.

units.source_text: 从早上一起床，我就惦记着昨晚的事情，所以路上又追问了他。

en.t: From the moment I got up that morning, last night’s matter had been on my mind, so I pressed him about it again on the way.

units.source_text: 然而他仍没有给出使我满意的回答。

en.t: But he still did not give me an answer that satisfied me.

units.source_text: 我就试探着问道：‘是不是关于那件事，你有什么话要跟我说？’

en.t: I asked tentatively, “Is there something you want to say to me about that matter?”

units.source_text: 他说话的口吻，听起来仿佛在提醒我，昨天在上野公园，不是说过‘这件事不要再提了’吗！

en.t: His tone sounded as if he were reminding me that yesterday in Ueno Park he had said, “Do not bring this matter up again.”

units.source_text: 在这类事情上，K是个自尊心极强的人。

en.t: In matters like this, K was a man with an extremely strong sense of pride.

units.source_text: 突然觉察到这一点时，我想起了他说过的‘下决心’这个词。

en.t: When I suddenly realized this, I remembered the word “resolve” that he had used.

units.source_text: 于是乎，一直没有在意过的这个词，沉甸甸地压在了我的心头。

en.t: Then that word, which I had never paid attention to before, began to weigh heavily on my heart.
